assessments.reasoning: Overriding Default Scalar Values documents explicit defaults on singular non-message fields and separates the absent presence bit from the resulting getter value. Enum Default Value covers an explicitly overridden enum default. A supplied value and an absent value with the same getter result still differ in presence.

challenge.method: Compared the absent scalar example to the pinned enum default, an explicit value equal to the default, and an inapplicable message field.
challenge.results: The explicit value and absent defaulted getter can be equal while their presence differs. Message fields are excluded. Sample HOME differs from its first enum value MOBILE, exercising explicit override in source form.

limitations: This is a proto2 documentation claim. It does not assert a particular generated getter name, default for a present field, or a universal rule about editions.
The assessment is confined to the named documents and revision scope.
